The '''Rogues' Den''' is a hideout located beneath a trapdoor in [[The Toad and Chicken]] inn in [[Burthorpe]], containing a variety of [[Thieving]] and [[Agility]] related activities. While there are no entry requirements, its main attraction is the Maze exploration minigame, which requires 50 Agility and 50 Thieving (unboostable). The maze is notable for offering a chance to earn pieces of [[Rogue equipment]], which provide a chance to receive double loot from [[Pickpocketing]]. Wearing the full set guarantees double loot. 

Outside of the maze there are several shops, a fire next to a bank, and four wall safes with a chance to provide [[uncut gem]]s up to [[diamond]] or 20 to 40 [[coins]] when cracked open.
